terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A surface-mounted ceiling fitting: nothing opens, turns or swings, nothing attaches, so one root pivot at the ceiling face and zero sockets. It hangs in -Y from a top-center origin. Shophouse ceilings, market stalls, undercrofts; rows of them. White enamel rusting at the fixings, a greyer interior, two warm tubes with grey end caps.

reasoning: ONE folded-sheet trough -- top plate, two 0.08 m side walls, two end plates, a folded lip, a ballast housing and four tube holders -- merged on one enamel material; ONE pair of tubes on an emissive material: TWO draw calls.
Two materials: white enamel (vertex colours: enamel, the greyer inner, grey holders, rust specks) and the lit tube.
No repetition system: two tubes are two cylinders in one merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, NO collider (declared none), not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is a bare open trough with two yellow tubes showing from below; the tubes are emissive because a fluorescent fitting reads as lit or reads as scrap, and the kit owns no light sources.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: A pressed steel channel open along its underside, built as three plates.
Two yellowed tubes lying in the channel.
A flat plate closing each end of the channel.
A threaded stem and box on top, within the declared 0.1 m band.
Rust flecks along the channel edges and inside it, as a canvas tile.
A cup in each end plate where the tube pins seat.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

resolvedUnknowns: Surface-mounted, no stem: the plate's pendant stem contradicts the description and the declared height.
The tubes are lit (emissive 0.9); an unlit tube would be a second material state the kit does not carry.
The plate's open-ended trough is closed with end plates, as a batten is.
preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.25 x 0.10 x 0.12 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus 0 named mechanism pivot(s); zero sockets; none collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

The turntable cannot show them: at its 20-degree elevation the camera looks down at a fitting that opens downward, so verification is a capture at --elevation -35.

featureReviewTargets.name: Enamel and rust
featureReviewTargets.criteria: Pressed steel with visible grime and rust, its inner faces distinguishable from its outer, and flat plates closing both ends.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The rigid body of the prop at its declared origin. A named pivot is a promise that a part turns on it, and only real mechanisms get one.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.
actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

The tubes are lit (emissive 0.9); an unlit tube would be a second material state the kit does not carry.
The plate's open-ended trough is closed with end plates, as a batten is.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin TOP-CENTER on the ceiling face, +Y up, the fitting hangs in -Y to -0.10; +Z the long front face. Ceiling and wall placements.

silhouette.description: A 1.25 x 0.10 x 0.12 m open box hanging from the ceiling, walls 0.08 m deep, lip 6 mm out at the bottom; two 26 mm tubes 56 mm apart at -0.062 m running 1.17 m between holders.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.625 (declared 1.25); y 0 at the ceiling to -0.10 (declared); z +-0.071 at the folded lip (declared 0.12, the lip 6 mm proud each side). The proxy normalises to w:h:d 1:0.861:0.588 -- a pendant STEM and a from-below view dominate it; its box reads full width from 0.02 to 0.54 H, and the description calls this a batten (surface-mounted), so the stem is not built and the declared 0.10 m height holds.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: w:h:d 1:0.861:0.588 with a pendant stem at 0.58-0.98 H (not built, see envelopeDerivation); the box body is 0.02-0.54 H at full width. No band table: the proxy's height axis is the stem.

componentTree.name: Open steel channel, end plates and conduit stem
componentTree.topologyRationale: The channel is THREE PLATES -- a top and two sides -- not a solid. The plate's fitting is open along its underside and you see straight into it; a solid box is what the previous build shipped and it hid the tubes entirely, which are the whole point of the prop.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Origin TOP-CENTER at the conduit stem, so the prop occupies y -0.1 to 0. A 1.25 m top plate at y -0.047, two 48 mm side walls at z +-0.0525, a flat end plate closing each end, a conduit box at y -0.034 and a threaded stem reaching the pivot at y 0.

localFeatures.description: Three plates leaving the underside open, so the channel reads as holding its tubes rather than as a closed slab.
A flat plate closing each end, which is what stops the channel reading as an extrusion cut off in mid-air.
A threaded stem and box on top, sitting INSIDE the declared 0.1 m band rather than standing above it, because the pivot is top-center.
Rust flecks along the channel's edges and inside it as a post-construction canvas tile, which the plate shows heavily.
A cup let into each end plate where the tube pins seat. Without them the tubes end against a flat plate and read as rods laid in a trough rather than as lamps in holders.

materials.name: White enamelled steel

roughness.localResponse: no map; a semi-gloss stove enamel whose grime is carried by a canvas tile bound after construction

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/enamel.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.800. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.evidence: crops/enamel.png -- rust specks at the screws; two tinted plates 1.2 mm proud.

evidence: Measured on viewEvidence region-enamel (0.80) at #90918c in the lip shadow and region-inner at #ac8a61 (warm tube spill); carried at #d8d8d4 outside and #c9c9c4 inside as vertex colours on a WHITE material.
Textureless as DECLARED: a 256 px grime canvas after construction.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

materials.notes: Pressed steel carrying the channel's inner faces, its end plates and its conduit stem as vertex colours, with grime and rust as a post-construction canvas tile. Luma 208, far above gatecrop's erased 55.5-60.5 window, so no tone correction was needed.

featureReviews.notes: Measured bbox 1.250 x 0.100 x 0.115 m against the declared 1.25 x 0.1 x 0.12 -- exact on length and height, 4% under on depth. The conduit stem sits INSIDE the 0.1 m band and reaches the top-center pivot at y 0 rather than standing above it, which is what a top-center pivot requires. The plate is a close-up of a SHORT two-tube fitting, so as everywhere in this kit the form comes from the plate and the proportion from the declaration.

TWO yellowed tubes lying in the channel, seated in a lampholder cup let into each end plate. The previous build was a closed box with no tubes at all. VERIFIED FROM BELOW rather than asserted: the turntable's 20-degree elevation looks slightly DOWN at a fitting that opens downward, so no turntable frame can show them -- a capture at --elevation -35 does, and there the pair of yellowed tubes in an open channel reads exactly as the plate's. That the identity feature is invisible at the review elevation is why this is 0.92 and not higher.

The channel is THREE PLATES -- a top and two sides -- leaving the underside open, with the inner faces a shade darker than the outer and a flat plate closing each end. A solid box is what the previous build shipped and it hid everything. Enamel #d0d2ce at luma 208 and tubes at 204, both far above gatecrop's erased 55.5-60.5 window, so neither needed the tone correction this kit's darker props needed. Grime and rust ride on a post-construction canvas tile.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Two components, no repetition system: 2 of 2.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 264 of 2,000: thirteen boxes and two 12-segment cylinders.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Thin boxes for every sheet of the trough; cylinders for the tubes.
No InstancedMesh: two tubes are one merge. In a scene the HOST instances the fitting along a ceiling.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. One 256 px grime canvas after construction, 0.25 MB of texture VRAM.
